incident_commander.title: Incident Commander
responsibilities: Declare incident severity and coordinate response
Authorize isolation actions and DR playbook trigger

communications_lead.title: Communications Lead
responsibilities: Draft user notifications using approved templates
Update status page and in-app banners

legal_advisor.title: Legal Advisor
responsibilities: Advise on regulatory notification for data leaks

api_kill_switch.description: Disable API write endpoints via kill switch

firewall_rules.description: Block suspicious IPs / geo at edge WAF

tenant_isolation_trigger.description: Isolate affected tenant — prevent cross-tenant data access

fee_db.note: N/A user-facing — recorded in security ops budget

breach.title: Security Breach
steps: Automated alert fires — on-call ack within 5 minutes
Incident Commander declared — assess blast radius
Activate API kill switch if active exploitation detected
Preserve logs and evidence — append-only audit chain
Rotate compromised credentials via secrets vault
Notify Legal Advisor within 15 minutes
Draft user notification — best effort language only
Trigger DR playbook if data integrity compromised
Run post-incident provenance lineage check (#945)
Run billing integrity check (#908)
Postmortem within 72 hours

data_leak.title: Data Leak
steps: Confirm scope of leaked data — tenant isolation check
Contain leak source — revoke access tokens
Legal Advisor notified immediately
Assess regulatory notification requirements
Notify affected users within 1 hour — approved template
Enable tenant isolation trigger for affected tenant
Run provenance lineage integrity check (#945)
Document timeline in immutable audit log

service_outage.title: Service Outage
steps: Confirm outage scope — /health/live, /health/ready
Technical Lead investigates root cause
Auto-trigger DR playbook for critical outage
Update status page — investigating / working to restore
Notify users within 1 hour if customer-facing
No guaranteed uptime language in communications
Restore service — verify production guard
Post-incident billing integrity check (#908)

ddos.title: DDoS Attack
steps: Confirm DDoS via edge metrics and rate limits
Activate WAF firewall rules — geo/rate limiting
Scale edge protection via CDN
Monitor legitimate traffic impact
Communicate via status page if user-visible degradation
Document attack vectors in audit log

key_compromise.title: Key / Credential Compromise
steps: Identify compromised key scope
Revoke and rotate via secrets vault immediately
API kill switch if signing keys compromised
Invalidate active sessions
Audit all access using compromised credentials
Notify users if their data may be affected — within 1 hour
Run billing idempotency replay protection test (#908)

critical_investigating.subject: Service Incident — We Are Investigating
critical_investigating.body: We are aware of an issue affecting our platform and are actively investigating. Our team is working to restore service on a best-effort basis. We will provide updates as our investigation progresses.

data_leak_notice.subject: Important Security Notice
data_leak_notice.body: We identified a security incident that may have affected some account data. We are investigating and have taken immediate containment steps. We will share more details as our investigation continues.

service_degraded.subject: Service Degradation — Investigating
service_degraded.body: Some platform features may be experiencing degraded performance. Our engineering team is investigating and working to restore normal operation.
